purpose: Finite-N pseudocritical transverse field of the published spin-glass Hamiltonian. This file is not a circuit fit and does not authorize one.
hamiltonian: H = sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j + B sum_i X_i
z_convention: Z|0> = +1, site q is bit q, least significant bit is site 0
J_law: i.i.d. Normal(0,1) on i<j, symmetric, zero diagonal, no Kac factor, no rescaling
field_map: B = Gamma * sqrt(N), Gamma = Gamma_milli/1000. Gamma is the transverse field of the normalized SK Hamiltonian. B is the coefficient in the author Hamiltonian.

binder.source: Mukherjee, Rajak, Chakrabarti, Phys. Rev. E 92, 042107 (2015), arXiv:1412.2973, equation (5) and the T=0 Binder formula
binder.Qk: N^{-k} sum_{i1...ik} <Z_{i1}...Z_{ik}>^2 on the lowest eigenvector
binder.note_Q1: Q1 uses <Z_i>, which vanishes in a spin-reflection eigenstate. It is recorded as a residual, not as the order parameter.

normalization_source: The printed SK density at J=1 is (N/(2*pi))^{1/2} exp(-N J_ij^2 / 2), i.e. Normal(0, variance 1/N). The prose line 'variance is J/sqrt(N)' disagrees with that density; the density is followed. Author variance is 1, so a shared eigenstate sits at B = Gamma * sqrt(N).

thermodynamic_anchor.role: infinite-N extrapolation quoted by that paper. Not the finite-N adoption value.

adoption.require: exactly one crossing of g_N - g_N' inside the window for both pairs (6,9) and (9,12)
adoption.Gamma_pseudo: mean of the two in-window crossings when the pair rule passes
adoption.B_cri: Gamma_pseudo * sqrt(N), one value per N, the same Gamma for every instance

not_an_input: location of the minimum same-symmetry gap
diagnostics_cannot_change_adoption: per-instance Gamma of the largest drop of that instance's Q2
argmin over this grid of the same-parity gap, full spectrum at N=6 and N=9 for k=0..7, truncated Lanczos at N=12
Q2 at the historical author field B=0.1

historical_B.role: author final ramp B_f and the previous circuit benchmark. Kept separate. Not B_cri.

mixer_versus_field: B_cri multiplies sum X inside the target Hamiltonian whose energy is scored. A QAOA mixer angle beta is not B_cri.
